_source: NASA CR-2144 (Heffley & Jewell 1972): 94 flight conditions of 10 aircraft, read from page images into cr2144_lateral.csv / cr2144_longitudinal.csv; lateral derivatives rotated to stability axes by alpha0. Acceptance envelopes (y_b, l_r, lateral_ratios) are the full observed range, which every real condition satisfies jointly (5th-95th percentiles would reject 44% of the real conditions). Sampling ranges for pedal, L/D, drag slope and M_u are the 5th-95th percentiles.
_conventions: Ratios are sign-convention invariant between CR-2144 (delta_r+ nose left) and this model (F_rp+ nose right). Dimensional derivatives are normalized by the object's own modes where they scale with them.
_lift_to_drag_note: effective L/D = -2 g / (X_u V); X_u includes thrust and Mach effects
_drag_slope_note: -(X_alpha - g)/g in stability axes, i.e. (dD/dalpha)/W with the trim-lift tilt removed
_m_u_note: 1/(m s), stability axes, converted from 1/(ft s); M_u < 0 is the speed-unstable (tuck) sense
_inertia_note: body axes, fighter subset (NT-33A, F-104A, F-4C) min-max; I_z drawn as a fraction of I_x + I_y (distinct-aircraft values 0.93-0.96, and a rigid body cannot exceed 1)
_span_note: class IV fighters, F-104 (6.7 m) to F-4 / T-33 (about 11.7-11.9 m), widened; not read from CR-2144 tables; only used by the rotary gust filters
_longitudinal_sampling_note: L/D, drag slope and M_u are 5th-95th percentiles of the 47 subsonic (Mach < 0.8) CR-2144 conditions, matching the subsonic V0 range of the library; transonic/supersonic conditions have |M_u| about three times larger (tuck).
_v3_sampling_note: v3 draws Y_b, N'_p/L'_p, L'_r/N'_r and eta uniformly inside these CR-2144 5th-95th percentiles; the derived ratios must then fall inside the full-range acceptance envelopes above
_envelope_note: research assumption for class IV speed ranges (MIL-STD-1797A PDF p.582); CR-2144 fighter power-approach speeds are about 69-80 m/s
_pedal_note: steady sideslip per pedal force in the Dutch-roll approximation, v1 research envelope (10 deg needs 50-500 N)
_quantile_note: Empirical quantiles (2.5th to 97.5th percentile, 21 evenly spaced levels) of CR-2144 conditions; v3 samples these two tail-linked ratios by inverse CDF so their real correlation with dihedral and Y_beta/N'_beta is kept. rudder_side_force_ratio Q = |Y*_dr/N'_dr| N'_b / |Y_b|; real fins give Q mostly below 1, which keeps the bank sense in steady sideslip.
_v4_note: v4 additions (2026-10-31). l_r_over_n_r_quantiles: 2.5-97.5 percentile, 21 levels, all 94 CR-2144 conditions in stability axes; v4 draws L'_r/N'_r by inverse CDF instead of uniformly over the 5-95 band. principal_axis_inclination_deg: body-axis principal inclination eps = atan2(2 I_xz, I_z - I_x)/2 of the fighter subset (NT-33A 1.37-1.42, F-4C 0.82-1.09, F-104A 2.76-2.86), min-max; v4 sets I_xz = (I_z - I_x) tan(2 eps)/2 instead of drawing I_xz/I_x independently. alpha_trim_offset_deg: body-axis trim alpha minus 1/(n/alpha) (alpha from zero lift, level flight) for the clean subsonic fighter conditions (config nominal, Mach <= 0.95; 15 conditions), min-max; v4 sets alpha_trim = 1/(n/alpha) + offset.
